text:
Let’s be honest about Jayden Daniels.

His team’s starting RB hasn’t eclipsed 850 rushing yards going on 3 seasons now.

His WR1 targets (Terry, Deebo, Diggs) have all been Age 29+; 30+ the past 2 years.

His team has not drafted a WR higher than RD3.

The only TE they’ve drafted (Ben Sinnott) has been a total bust.

His offensive-line has ranked outside the Top-20 in Pass-Block Grade in 2/3 seasons.

He’s gotten very little help.
